briefing: Markets drifted slightly lower today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.4%) with no clear risk-on catalyst. Cash ($289.29) remains below the $500 deployment threshold, so per strategy memory we held all 7 existing positions and skipped new buys rather than forcing a trade on a neutral day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off describes a mindset where investors pull back from adding new risk and prefer holding cash until conditions clarify. Today's mixed, mildly negative market didn't show the multi-signal confirmation (volume surge, strong RSI/MACD alignment) needed for high-conviction buys, so the disciplined choice was to sit tight rather than deploy capital just because slots were open.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避（Risk-Off）」是指投資人在市況不明朗時，傾向減少新增風險部位、寧可持有現金觀望。今日市場走勢溫和偏弱，且未出現成交量放大、RSI與MACD同步走強等高信心買進訊號，因此紀律上的正確做法是按兵不動，而不是因為還有空餘倉位就勉強進場。

market_education.summary_en: Both the Nasdaq and S&P 500 slipped modestly today, with no single dominant headline driving the move — trading looked more like cautious drift than a decisive risk-off event. Volume and conviction were light across the screened momentum names, with most bullish setups still intact but not accelerating. Without a fresh catalyst or volume surge, there wasn't enough evidence of institutional buying to justify committing new capital.
market_education.summary_zh: 納指與標普500今日小幅走弱，並無單一重大消息主導盤面，走勢較像是觀望性的緩步下滑，而非明確的風險規避。篩選名單中的多頭動能股大多維持原有格局，但缺乏成交量放大等加速跡象。在沒有新催化劑或量能突破的情況下，並無足夠證據顯示有機構資金進場，因此不宜貿然加碼新倉位。
